# KeralaCabs

> Premium Car Rentals in Kerala, India

KeralaCabs provides luxury self-drive car rentals, chauffeur-driven tours, and premium wedding car services across Kerala. We offer a high-end fleet for tourists, locals, and special events.

## Key Services

- **Self-Drive Rentals:** Rent premium cars to explore Kerala at your own pace.
- **Chauffeur-Driven Tours:** Hire a luxury vehicle with an experienced professional driver.
- **Wedding Cars:** Premium cars available for weddings and special events, especially in Kochi and surrounding areas.

## Site Structure

- **Home (`/`)**: Main landing page, overview of services and fleet.
- **Fleet (`/fleet`)**: Browse our full collection of available premium cars, their features, and booking options.
- **Contact (`/contact`)**: Reach out to us for bookings, inquiries, and customer support.

## Contact Information
You can book a car or reach us by navigating to `https://www.keralacabs.in/contact`.
